About the Surgeon

Dr. Saurav
Shetty K

MBBS · MS General Surgery · MCh Plastic Surgery

Dr. Saurav Shetty K is a plastic and cosmetic surgeon with comprehensive training from Dr. D. Y. Patil Medical College, Hospital & Research Centre, Pune — one of India's premier tertiary care centres. Currently serving as Senior Resident, he brings operative independence across a wide spectrum of surgical procedures.

With rotational experience across GI Surgery, Surgical Oncology, CTVS, and Surgical ICU, and award-winning conference presentations and peer-reviewed publications, Dr. Shetty blends rigorous academic training with a refined eye for aesthetic outcomes — especially tuned to the nuances of Indian skin and beauty ideals.

What We Offer

Signature Procedures

01
Rhinoplasty
Precision nose reshaping that harmonises with your natural features and cultural aesthetic.
02
Facelift & Neck Lift
Restoring youthful contour and skin elasticity with advanced lifting techniques.
03
Blepharoplasty
Eyelid correction for a refreshed, alert look — respecting the natural shape of South Asian eyes.
04
Body Contouring
Liposuction and sculpting procedures tailored to your unique body shape and goals.
05
Breast Surgery
Augmentation, reduction and lift procedures with naturalness and balance as primary goals.
06
Scar Revision
Minimising the appearance of scars using the latest surgical and non-surgical methods.
07
Skin Rejuvenation
Treatments designed specifically for Indian skin tones — addressing pigmentation, texture, and tone.
08
Reconstructive Surgery
Restoring form and function following trauma, disease, or congenital conditions.
